_comment: Reviewed list of corpus artefacts that are KNOWN not to migrate. scripts/check_corpus_gate.py treats it as an exact match in both directions: an artefact that fails and is not listed fails the gate, and a listed artefact that now migrates, fails differently or reports other blockers fails the gate too, so this file can only shrink towards empty. Keys are '<batch>/<artefact path inside the batch>'. 'category' is the batch state's error category, every 'details' fragment must occur in its error details (keep them free of absolute paths), 'blockers' is the exact set of quality-report blockers, and 'reason' says why the limitation is accepted. Do not add an entry to silence a regression.

The Hyper API refuses it ('invalid magic value in header'), so no complete CSV/Parquet export can be produced, and sampling or falling back to the historical live source is not acceptable. Re-saving the extract as .hyper in Tableau Desktop would make it migratable.

real_world/tableau_prep_book.tfl.reason: The observed SimpleUnion namespaceFieldMappings dialect is now supported, but this real flow from 'Visual Analytics with Tableau' still rejects the later SimpleJoin action inside SuperJoin. Left/right inputs and equality keys are declared, but result-field selection and duplicate-key/collision semantics are not established; aliasing it to the existing Join parser would invent a projection. Separately, the mapped union inputs declare incompatible string/real fields without an explicit cast. The measured first blocker remains exact, with no fields discarded or types guessed to force success.
